title: Monotonicity of exterior Fourier weight
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $A$ and $B$ be families of subsets of the coordinates with $A\subseteq B$. The sum of the squared Fourier coefficients of $f$ over sets outside $B$ is at most the corresponding sum over sets outside $A$.
hypotheses_covered: real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
